title: CodeChallenge: Numerical scaling issues in DL models

cues.en: In the previous section, you learned that softmax is a simple and powerful transformation, but that
cues.zh: 上一節學過，softmax 簡單而強大，

cues.en: it's also quite sensitive to the numerical scale of the data.
cues.zh: 但對資料的數值尺度也很敏感。

cues.en: So the purpose of this code challenge is to continue exploring that concept, and also the implications of repeatedly multiplying matrices.
cues.zh: 這個程式挑戰要繼續探索，還要看反覆相乘矩陣的影響。

cues.en: In this code challenge, you will see exactly why the Q transpose matrix in the attention algorithm
cues.zh: 你會明確看到，為什麼注意力演算法中的 Q Kᵀ 矩陣，

cues.en: needs to be scaled by the square root of the dimensionality.
cues.zh: 需要以維度的平方根縮放。

cues.en: Lots of fun here.
cues.zh: 有很多樂趣。

cues.en: Lots of learning.
cues.zh: 也會學很多。

cues.en: So let's begin in exercise one.
cues.zh: 先從練習一開始。

cues.en: Create 250 by 50 random numbers matrices.
cues.zh: 建立兩個 50 × 50 的隨機數矩陣。

cues.en: So matrices that are created using Numpy's random function.
cues.zh: 使用 NumPy 的隨機函數建立。

cues.en: And you want these to be random numbers drawn from a Gaussian distribution, a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 要使用高斯，也就是常態分布的隨機數。

cues.en: One of these matrices you can call Q and the other one you can call k.
cues.zh: 一個叫 Q，另一個叫 K。

cues.en: And then you can multiply them together to get q k transpose.
cues.zh: 接著相乘，得到 Q Kᵀ。

cues.en: And then from these three matrices you should calculate their standard deviations and the square roots of their dimensionalities.
cues.zh: 對三個矩陣，計算標準差，以及維度的平方根。

cues.en: You can print out that information in your Python notebook like what I have here.
cues.zh: 像這樣，在 Python 筆記本印出資訊。

cues.en: Now because these are Gaussian distributed numbers, we expect the standard deviation of q and k to be one, or at least very close to one.
cues.zh: 因為是高斯分布，預期 Q、K 的標準差為 1，或非常接近 1。

cues.en: Now this variable dp that is q transpose.
cues.zh: 這個變數 dp，就是 Q Kᵀ。

cues.en: So the question is what will be the standard deviation of QQ transpose.
cues.zh: 問題是，Q Kᵀ 的標準差會是多少？

cues.en: Next you should plot all of the matrix values in a scatter plot.
cues.zh: 接著把所有矩陣值畫成散佈圖。

cues.en: So here are the numerical values of the matrices on the x axis, and there are three rows in this plot
cues.zh: x 軸是矩陣的數值，圖上有三列，

cues.en: corresponding to the three matrices that you've created.
cues.zh: 對應建立的三個矩陣。

cues.en: This is a horizontally oriented scatter plot.
cues.zh: 這是水平方向的散佈圖。

cues.en: I've blanked out a lot of the results on this slide, because before you run your code, I want you
cues.zh: 投影片遮住很多結果，是希望執行程式前，

cues.en: to think about what you expect the numbers and the scatter plot to look like.
cues.zh: 先思考預期的數字與圖形。

cues.en: Now, I can already tell you that the standard deviation of k is going to be one.
cues.zh: 已經可以告訴你，K 的標準差會是 1。

cues.en: The question is, what will be the standard deviation of qk transpose and what will be the square root of 50?
cues.zh: 問題是 Q Kᵀ 的標準差，以及 50 的平方根會是多少。

cues.en: And then what you should think about is what you expect the scatter plots here to look like.

cues.en: So think about the results, what you expect the results to look like before you actually discover them.

cues.en: This is a simple exercise in terms of coding, but I think it's going to help you understand why we
